Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the candid update in Friday's call. From your note it sounds like procurement sign-off and an internal security review will push acceptance out by ~3 weeks, which would mean your evaluation cutover window slides past the originally agreed go-live. We want to keep momentum and avoid losing engineering time on both sides.

High-level ask: would DeltaHealth accept a 21-day MAP extension with a short-term credit bridge for the reserved slot (our proposed credit covers the reserved compute allocation for the delayed week-of-acceptance)?

Key changes in the attachment: bullet list:
- Reordered acceptance tasks to front-load the security evidence handoff so procurement can run in parallel with the final integration sprint.
- Contingency lane B: accept a limited feature set on initial cutover (analytics disabled) to shorten production verification window.
- Credit proposal (page 3): a 50% reserved-cap credit for the first two weeks of the delay, applied as a one-time invoice credit.

Can you confirm by Wednesday whether procurement will sign the updated SOW by 12/10? If yes, we can lock the credit and update the MAP in DocuSign. If procurement needs more runway, we can escalate a limited credit + reserved-cap hold to our finance team.

Att: Delta_MPA_v1.xlsx; procurement_timeline.csv

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
